subject: An elderly Tamil woman in her late 60s with silver-streaked hair tied in a loose kondai bun, wearing a handloom Madurai Sungudi cotton sari in deep maroon with a mustard tie-dye border, small gold jhumkas, and a simple kumkum bottu, leaning forward to draw a geometric pulli kolam using wet rice flour paste between her thumb and forefinger

setting.place: The front thinnai verandah and swept threshold of a 1920s Chettinad mansion in Karaikudi, Tamil Nadu, featuring carved Burma teak pillars, Athangudi handmade patterned floor tiles, lime-plastered walls, and a small lit brass kuthuvilakku lamp resting on a banana leaf beside a brass sombu of water
setting.era: Contemporary everyday heritage, timeless rural Tamil Nadu

lighting: Low-angle warm morning sunlight slanting across the courtyard, casting long architectural pillar shadows and illuminating dust motes in the air

camera.angle: Eye-level slightly angled along the verandah pillars to show architectural depth

style: Naturalistic documentary photography, candid 35mm film grain, authentic skin texture, unposed editorial realism
